getWomen.description: RF02: the users of gender FEMENINO (with all their columns, for the list)
getWomen.sql: SELECT * FROM users u WHERE u.gender = 'FEMENINO'

getUsDomain.description: RF03: the users whose email domain is us.es (with all their columns, for the list)
getUsDomain.sql: SELECT * FROM users u WHERE f_get_email_domain(u.email) = 'us.es'
